structured_facts.statement: PubMed indexes a September 2026 Lancet Oncology report of the multinational randomized double-blind phase 3 HARMONi trial, PMID 42636833 and DOI 10.1016/S1470-2045(26)00282-2.

The abstract describes 438 participants with advanced non-squamous EGFR-mutated NSCLC after progression on a third-generation EGFR tyrosine-kinase inhibitor, randomized 219 per group at 114 centers across Asia, Europe and North America.
The abstract reports median progression-free survival of 6.8 months versus 4.4 months, hazard ratio 0.52 (95% CI 0.41-0.66; p<0.0001).
The abstract reports median overall survival of 16.8 months versus 14.0 months, hazard ratio 0.79 (95% CI 0.62-1.01).
The PubMed record links an October 2026 correction, PMID 42805208; the correction text was not available in the bounded review and its substantive effect remains unverified.

limitations: Only the public PubMed bibliographic record and abstract were reviewed; the full article was not reproduced or independently reanalyzed.
The abstract records Summit Therapeutics funding.
The linked correction has not been substantively reviewed.
This evidence does not establish an individual prognosis, hospital-specific outcome, cross-modality ranking or treatment recommendation.
copyright_boundary: Structured facts only; consult PubMed and the publisher for the source record and full article.
